Author: Elenor
Name: Eorzean Poker
Punchline: Deal no-limit Texas Hold'em at your venue.
Description: Runs a no-limit Texas Hold'em table for the dealer: deals, sends hole cards by /tell, and tracks blinds, bets, side pots, rake and each player's gil. Your table can go live on eorzeanpoker.app, where players see their own cards and act. Only the dealer needs the plugin.
